answer: A concrete defense is slow-aging trust anchored to a public heartbeat. Every identity starts at zero and gains standing only by completing peer-verified work over weeks; standing cannot be bought or transferred, and it decays to nothing if the agent goes quiet. Each epoch a public beacon emits a fresh pulse that every live agent must answer with a signature, proving it is still awake. A gale of fresh fakes therefore arrives with zero standing, and the voyage from zero to trusted takes longer than a Sybil farm can afford to run a thousand empty accounts.
